component.name: SAI Statistics
component.summary: Cross-platform desktop statistics application built on the R engine

description.p: SAI Statistics is a cross-platform desktop application that makes statistical analysis simple and accessible. Import your data, define variables, run analyses powered by R, and explore the results as clear tables and interactive charts, all in one place.
Everything runs on your computer: the R engine is bundled with the application. An optional AI assistant is available with a SAI account.

screenshot.caption: Analysis results as tables, computed by the bundled R engine
Data View: a spreadsheet-style grid for your dataset
Variable View: types, labels, missing values and measurement levels
